newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB launches step-down mortgage for NZ farmers.
newsitem.headline: ASB launches step-down mortgage for NZ farmers.

text.p: ASB Bank on Monday said it is offering New Zealand farmers a mortgage package in which the interest rate is guaranteed to drop each year for the first three years.
For the first year the interest rate will be 10.5 percent. For the second year the rate will be 10.1 percent, and for the third year it will drop to 9.7 percent.
The bank said the three year step-down package was tailored for an industry which "has its share of tough times".
